categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet area label and modifies the legacy Berkeley DB wallet migration parser in src/wallet/migrate.cpp.
categories.rationale: Hardens the legacy-to-descriptor BDB parser against hangs, exponential processing time, and severe memory blowup on malformed database files. The PR description notes that on master an '~8 KB file built this way doesn't finish' and 'a 256 KB file took migratewallet from 54 MB to ~800 MB', with reviewer testing confirming that self-referencing overflow pages hang master.
